license_activation.title: License Activation Record
license_activation.description: Information about a validated 13-character mixed alphanumeric license key activated on a specific hardware signature.

deviceId.description: Hardware/device fingerprint signature representing single-PC lock

activatedAt.description: Timestamp indicating when activation took place

project_record.title: Media Studio Project Record
project_record.description: A structured project workspace document storing related photo/video assets, project-relevant tasks, status details, and client contacts.

id.description: The unique identifer key for this project

title.description: The user-assigned display title of the media campaign

description.description: Summary or objective statement of the client campaign

client.description: Client demographic and details details map record

assets.description: Nested media catalogs containing photos, videos and designs details

tasks.description: Nested task checklists aligned with priorities and states

createdAt.description: System millisecond or relative epoch timestamp denoting initial build

updatedAt.description: System millisecond clock recording last modification

/licenses/{licenseId}.description: Registry of license activations mapped by their 13-char uppercase key

/projects/{projectId}.description: A database collection storing full-stack client project pipelines and asset trackers
